steps.title: Revolve the float
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as float_hull.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the floor). Circle diameter 500 on the origin. Finish Sketch.
Extrude 1020 mm up. The origin is the bottom of the float; the design waterline is 770 mm up.

steps.title: Round the top and bottom edges
actions: Fillet the top edge radius 30 and the bottom edge radius 50. Click OK.
steps.note: Round edges shed waves and are kind to boats that touch the buoy.

steps.title: Fender groove
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Rectangle 12 deep by 80 high on the outside edge, from 910 to 990 mm up.
Revolve it 360 degrees about the Y axis, Cut.
steps.note: The rubber fender sits in this groove.

steps.title: Equipment well
actions: Hole on the top face, on the centre: diameter 290, depth 480. Click OK.
steps.note: The well holds the stainless equipment canister (sub-assembly 2).

steps.title: Hollow it
actions: Click Shell. Thickness 6 mm, Inside, no faces removed (a closed shell). Click OK.
steps.note: Rotomoulding makes a hollow part with an even wall. The space is then filled with foam (part 2).

steps.title: Tie rod holes
actions: Hole: diameter 16, Through All, at radius 195 on 30, 150 and 270 degrees (Circular Pattern of 3).
Material: Polyethylene, red (green for an entrance buoy). Save.
steps.note: Three stainless tie rods clamp the deck plate and the keel plate to the float.
